scoring_notes: All full-corpus absence statements are scoped to this frozen finite corpus, not claims about all private or future experiments.
Ambiguous provided material wording is conservatively interpreted as retrieved context; it is separately flagged rather than inflated into an unambiguous fabricated-fact count.
e03 has an unjustified insufficient assessment but still gives the correct central answer, so it is not counted as whole-answer false refusal.
e05 refuses the quantitative central comparison while correctly distinguishing metrics, so it is counted as partial false refusal.
Strict correctness requires all frozen material facts/scope, including the documented-vs-measured distinctions. Correct general caution alone can receive partial credit.
